metadata.title: Accountability and Oversight

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for assigning, enforcing, and auditing human accountability for AI system behavior and outcomes.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: AI governance, human-in-the-loop systems, oversight workflows, and socio-technical accountability frameworks.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern defining how responsibility, oversight authority, and escalation are enforced for AI systems and agentic behavior.

props.name: threat-framework
props.remarks: Provides AI-specific threat context for accountability gaps, attribution loss, and diffusion of responsibility in AI systems.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats where AI behavior cannot be clearly attributed to accountable human roles or governance authorities.

props.name: ai-threat-class
props.remarks: Threats arising when AI systems operate without clear human ownership, oversight, or escalation paths.

metadata.remarks: Accountability and Oversight defines how responsibility for AI systems is formally assigned and enforced. This pattern ensures that AI behavior—whether advisory, autonomous, or delegated—remains governed by identifiable human authority structures, preventing diffusion of responsibility or unaccountable operation.

components.title: Accountable Owner Definition
components.description: Formal assignment of accountable human owners or governance bodies for each AI system or agentic deployment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Each AI system has an explicitly designated accountable owner responsible for its behavior, outcomes, and compliance.

components.title: Human Override and Escalation
components.description: Mechanisms enabling authorized humans to pause, override, or escalate AI behavior when risk or harm is detected.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorized personnel can intervene in AI operation through pause, override, or escalation capabilities.

components.title: Auditability of Decisions
components.description: Preservation of records linking AI decisions and actions to accountable humans and governance approvals.

implemented-requirements.remarks: AI decisions and actions are auditable and traceable to human authority, approvals, and oversight actions.
